reason: Complete batch coverage found unresolved prerequisite-proof gaps and page-scope alignment issues. The common-development and maximal-development claims cannot be accepted until the owner resolves them.

findings.reason: Supplier proof step 3.1 chooses a finite cover of the whole causal arc by sets inside I+(p) while trying to prove that the arc lies in I+(p); it gives no first-exit argument, leaving a circular gap. Direct assigned consumers include lem-gr-subdevelopment-convexity, lem-gr-isometric-immersion-rigidity, lem-gr-corresponding-boundary-structure, lem-gr-boundary-null-geodesic-segment, lem-gr-exposed-boundary-point, lem-gr-spacelike-restart-hypersurface, lem-gr-partial-cauchy-development, lem-gr-no-corresponding-boundary-points, lem-gr-universal-development, and ex-gr-flat-restart-level-set. The cited full [Chruściel proof](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1110.6706) uses a finite elementary-region argument that this supplier does not include.

Statement (i) asserts uniform convergence on [0,b], but each alpha_k is defined only on [0,b_k]. Proof step 4.1 evaluates alpha_k(t) up to b without ensuring b_k>=b or defining a common-domain extension or reparametrization. lem-gr-time-separation-maximizers consumes this in steps 2.1 and 4.1; its result is then used by the restart lemma and flat-level-set example.

Proof step 5.1 does not establish part (c) when both endpoints lie in I-(Sigma): it applies part (b) to the time-reversed curve, but part (b) requires an endpoint on Sigma. Extend the curve from its final endpoint to Sigma and apply part (b) to the concatenation, or give an equivalent argument.

Definition clause (d) asserts that corresponding-boundary witnesses must lie on exactly one side of the initial surface. This uses the trichotomy in lem-gr-cauchy-set-topology-and-graph, which is cited in the clause but absent from deps and dependency_roles.

The approved plan declares GR14 as the A-page prerequisite, while the current A carrier also requires the-zfc-axioms-and-basic-set-constructions and whitney-embedding-tubular-neighbourhoods-and-approximation, used by the MCD/set-formation and boundary-extension items. The owner must resolve this undeclared prerequisite page closure.

The current B carrier additionally requires gr-flat-and-newtonian-bridges, which is absent from the approved GR15B design and canonical plan and is unused by the assigned examples. Resolve this extra outside-batch page prerequisite.
